completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Electricity (Repurposing of Installations) Regulations 2025 and come into operation on 1 July 2025.
2. The relevant installations specified in the Schedule are excluded from the application of section 38A of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Regulation 2
Excluded relevant installations
1. Any generating unit with a generation capacity of less than 10 MW.
2. Any generating unit specified in the third column of the First Schedule to the Electricity (Electricity Generation and Retail Licence) (Exemption) Order (O 1), located on the premises specified in the second column of that Schedule against that generating unit.
